facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but under CEMAC exchange control; repatriate earnings through your bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: No: residents can't open foreign-currency accounts locally; declare accounts abroad.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register an individual enterprise at the ANPI-Gabon one-stop shop (RCCM and NIF together).
facts.L2_tax_id: NIF from the tax administration (DGI), issued at ANPI registration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Under FCFA 30m turnover, the ISL synthetic tax applies, online sellers included.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT above about FCFA 60m turnover; sources conflict on the threshold.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 025/2023: declare automated data processing to the APDPVP.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw from online purchases within 14 calendar days.
facts.L7_incentives: No freelancer incentive; the ISL regime under FCFA 30m is the main simplification.

watch_out.text: Declare any accounts you hold abroad to the BEAC.
